agency.description: Preference for sponsoring agency of the project
agency.pmegpRule: PMEGP applicants select their preferred implementing agency

gender.pmegpRule: Used for subsidy percentage qualification (Women get concessional rates)

location.description: Unit location type as per revenue record
location.pmegpRule: Margin money percentages differ for Rural vs Urban

category.description: Social category the applicant belongs to
category.pmegpRule: Affects own contribution percentage and margin money

businessType.description: Whether the project is manufacturing or service unit
businessType.pmegpRule: Subsidy caps differ (Manufacturing: up to ₹50L, Service: up to ₹20L)

education.pmegpRule: Education level determines subsidy cap tier (below 8th vs 8th+)

premises.description: Type of premises for the project
premises.pmegpRule: Premises type recorded for DPR but not used in financial calculations
